title: Senior Analyst, Data Glossary-3
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Data Glossary-3Overview  
The Senior Analyst, Data Glossary is responsible for the glossary content creation within the enterprise data glossary for assigned data sets and domains. This includes curating the data to be included by ensuring the critical data elements are appropriately identified, categorizing and classifying data, applying business term naming and definition standards, facilitating the rationalization of business terms at an enterprise level across business units, and ensuring content is represented accurately within tooling. This individual will serve as a semantic subject matter expert for assigned data domains and/or data sets as Mastercard expands its data management program and strategy within the office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO).  
  
This role is within the Data Management & Strategy team, with reporting structure up to the Chief Data Officer.
  
  
Role  

* Coordinate and communicate with data subject matter experts and other stakeholders to curate and proof the content to be included in the data glossary for assigned data domains, ensuring business terms conform to standards.
* Normalize terms cross-functionally, ensuring no term duplicates, and facilitating consensus among competing stakeholders.
* Ensure content is loaded and maintained in enterprise tooling. Participate in the identification and implementation of controls to ensure glossary integrity.
* Collaborate closely with team members and cross-functional teams to ensure content and process alignment. Contribute to process automation and streamlining operational procedures.
* Assist in researching and evaluating external related standards.
* Align with established data categories and concepts that may be managed by other team members.
* Solicit and incorporate continuous feedback from communities of interest and other stakeholders to improve data semantic models while maintaining governance.
* Assist with the creation and maintenance of standards and best practices related to the data glossary, including business term naming and definition standards. Solicit and incorporate continuous feedback from the community and other stakeholders.
* Assist with the training of new data glossary resources.
* Coordinate with Operations & Technology support teams to report, track, and escalate any tool issues or defects impacting the performance or usability of the data glossary tools
* Serve as a data-driven change agent and advocate, persuading and influencing the organization at the grassroots level.

All About You  
  

* Excellent writing skills, including the ability to concisely and precisely convey information to the intended audience in an easy to understand, unambiguous manner.
* Advanced Excel skills are desirable, intermediate required at a minimum.
* Demonstrated experience in working with data.
* Demonstrated experience with the application of standards.
* Hands-on experience with projects involving an enterprise glossary, thesaurus, or controlled vocabulary.
* Highly-motivated self-starter with the ability to multi-task between strategy-related work and tactical ‘in the trenches’ work, while working under deadlines. Ability to produce effective business results while under time pressures.
* Ability to understand and analyze complex information products, systems and processes and to break down complex concepts into clear articulated information to aid organizational understanding and identify common themes.
* Any experience related to data management or data governance including working with data dictionaries, metadata management solutions, data models, data lineage, data quality, data and analytics solutions, data categorization, defining the properties and relationships of concepts, data classification, and data issue tracking is an advantage.
* Strong interpersonal communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
* Without direct authority, ability to motivate and influence others to achieve organization goals.
* Experience in the technology and/or finance industries is helpful.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
NVIDIA's Enterprise Security team is looking for a Senior Engineer responsible for maintaining and advancing our Identity Governance and Access Management platforms. This is a high-impact role at the center of NVIDIA's Zero Trust security journey — one that combines deep technical ownership with the opportunity to shape how a world-class technology company secures its identity infrastructure! Are you passionate about identity security and ready to make a measurable difference at scale? Here's what the role looks like.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

The Senior Engineer will build the strategy, planning, and management of our enterprise-wide Zero Trust architecture while driving continuous improvements across Active Directory, Entra ID, and SailPoint environments. Working alongside multi-functional teams, this position focuses on designing and implementing robust security policies and access controls, and providing technical mentorship on infrastructure improvements, third-party integrations, and platform upgrades across the organization.

This role holds accountability for the strategy, roadmap, and operations of our identity management and governance — ensuring tight alignment with our broader Zero Trust initiatives. A key part of the work involves spotting process gaps, implementing improvements, and establishing engineering guidelines that set the standard for the entire team. Specific responsibilities include:

* Implementing identity security capabilities such as SSO, conditional access, MFA, and privileged access.
* Administering and evolving the SailPoint IdentityNow environment, including governance workflows, access certifications, role management, and integrations with enterprise applications.
* Managing vendor relationships to resolve issues and deliver new platform features.
* Championing development standards and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Applying AI tooling to improve infrastructure visibility and stability: telemetry, health checks, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted diagnostics that surface issues before users report them and give end users faster, self-service resolution.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of solid experience in handling Active Directory and Entra ID environments.
* Strong command of authentication protocols including LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, and OAuth.
* Experience with MFA and SSO technologies.
* Expertise across the full identity lifecycle: User Lifecycle Management, Access Certifications, Access Requests, role management, Workflow automation, and Delegated Administration.
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and operational tasks, plus practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day engineering work.
* Hands-on experience with an Identity Governance platform — SailPoint IdentityNow or IdentityIQ strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience resolving intricate identity and access challenges.

**Overview**

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features.
* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.

* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

Operational Management

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners.
* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.
* Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits.
* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

Governance, Security and Risk

* Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements.
* Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.
* Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
* Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer.

The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous.
* Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI.
* Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support.
* Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes.
* Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous.
* Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation.
* Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review.
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  + Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Contribute to secure software platforms used in complex connected products.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview
  
  
DNEG is seeking a security professional to assess applications, cloud services, AI use
  
cases, and third-party tools before and during their use across the company. The role
  
combines practical security architecture reviews with hands-on evaluation of security
  
solutions. The successful candidate will document risks, recommend workable controls,
  
and support informed approval decisions.
  
  
Mandatory Requirements and Expectations
  
  

* Own defined security reviews independently and escalate material risks or

complex decisions to senior security stakeholders.
  

* Provide clear, evidence-based recommendations that account for security risk,

business use, and implementation effort.
  

* Work closely with engineering, cloud, product, and other internal teams to

understand designs and agree on practical actions.
  

* Maintain accurate review records, decisions, conditions, and follow-up actions for

the security approval process.
  

* Communicate findings constructively to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.
  
Duties and Operational Responsibilities
  

* Review application and API designs for authentication, authorization, data

protection, secure integration, and common attack paths.
  

* Perform threat modelling for new systems and significant changes, and

recommend controls that can be implemented and verified.
  

* Assess cloud architectures and configurations, including identity, network

exposure, secrets, encryption, logging, and workload security.
  

* Review proposed AI applications and services for data exposure, access control,

unsafe outputs, prompt injection, and third-party dependencies.
  

* Evaluate third-party tools before company use by reviewing their security

posture, data flows, permissions, integrations, and relevant assurance evidence.
  

* Plan and run proof of concepts for application, cloud, and AI security tools using

agreed evaluation criteria; document effectiveness, integration needs, and
  
limitations.
  

* Prepare concise risk assessments and recommendations, including proposed

conditions or remediation needed before approval.
  

* Track findings with system and service owners, validate remediation evidence,

and identify unresolved risks for escalation.
  
  

* Contribute to security standards, review checklists, and reusable design

guidance to improve consistency across assessments.
  
  
Mandatory Job Requirements
  
  
A successful candidate should demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:
  

* Approximately five years of relevant experience in application security, cloud

security, security engineering, or security architecture.
  

* Experience reviewing application designs and applying secure development

practices, threat modelling, and risk-based remediation.
  

* Working knowledge of application and API security testing, including code,

dependency, and dynamic testing approaches.
  

* Hands-on understanding of security controls in at least one major cloud platform,

particularly identity, networking, data protection, and monitoring.
  

* Ability to evaluate unfamiliar technologies through proof of concepts, define

success criteria, and present a balanced recommendation.
  

* Experience assessing third-party products or services, including how they

access, process, store, and share company or client data.
  

* Working knowledge of security risks in AI-enabled applications and the controls

used to address them.

**Role Overview:**

As a Product and Solution Security Expert (PSSE) in Grid Software, you are the cybersecurity backbone for mission-critical Operational Technology (OT) deployments. You will act as the trusted security authority interfacing between our R&D organizations, project engineering teams, and major transmission/distribution system operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Your mission is to secure our advanced SCADA, ADMS, and grid automation solutions against evolving threat landscapes without compromising the strict availability and real-time performance demands of critical infrastructure. You will champion our security posture—safeguarding legacy integration layers while driving robust, secure architectures for modern deployments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer & Stakeholder Cybersecurity Leadership: Serve as the primary security interface for high-stakes customer projects, leading security alignment workshops, architecture reviews, and defending our security posture against rigorous customer specifications and regulatory frameworks (e.g., NIS2, IEC 62443).
* Secure Architecture & Integration: Oversee the secure design, hardening, and network segmentation of SCADA/EMS solutions deployed in customer environments. Ensure seamless integration of identity and access management (IAM), secure logging, and patch management workflows.
* Risk & Vulnerability Management: Apply our post-freeze risk scorecard methodologies. Evaluate 3rd-party software vulnerabilities using Environmental CVSS, reachability analysis (VEX), and exploit probability (EPSS/KEV) to advise Project Managers and Product Security Officers (PSSOs) on risk-based release decisions.
* Compliance & Certification Support: Drive adherence to IEC 62443-3-3 standards across project lifecycles, preparing documentation, security targets, and evidence for customer audits and factory/site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT).
* Incident Preparedness & Incident Engineering: Collaborate with project teams and incident response units to define fail-open contingency designs, ensuring grid availability takes precedence while containment and remediation occur safely.

**Key Deliverables:**

1. Project Security Architecture & Risk Assessments: Comprehensive security design documents, threat models (STRIDE), and system-specific risk assessments for every assigned critical infrastructure project.

2. Security-Gate Sign-offs: Authoritative security reviews and gate approvals at key project milestones (Architecture, FAT, SAT, Go-Live), backed by quantified risk-mitigation plans.

3. Vulnerability & Patch Management Runbooks: Tailored operational guidelines and risk-scoring rationales for customers handling 3rd-party component patching in live SCADA environments.

4. Regulatory & Audit Artifacts: Audit-ready compliance packages mapping project implementations to IEC 62443 and national critical infrastructure protection (CIP) standards.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Zero Unmitigated Critical Exposures: High-risk vulnerabilities and architectural gaps are identified, triaged, and mitigated proactively before system integration or customer sign-off.
* Trusted Advisor Status: You earn the absolute confidence of customer CISOs and Bid- and Project Managers by explaining complex OT cybersecurity trade-offs with clarity, pragmatism, and authority.
* Resilient Delivery Without Compromise: Grid availability and performance are never sacrificed; your security frameworks ensure that fail-open mechanisms and robust risk management protect the grid while maintaining operational uptime.
* Seamless Collaboration: Engineering teams, PSSOs, and external partners view you not as a compliance bottleneck, but as an enabler who embeds security cleanly into the delivery lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity within Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Deep working knowledge of IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and European cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NIS2, CRA).
* Hands-on experience with threat modeling, secure network architectures (Purdue Model, firewalls, datadiodes), Identiy and Access Management concepts and vulnerability triaging tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English
